title: 第16章 巴老第17章 九宫八卦阵
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
三人，来到会客室
钱有道严肃认真的问道
“叶小友对多多所言可是真的”
“此事我乃亲眼所见，”叶辰正色回答
“好，既然叶小友亲眼所见，那不知叶小友可有良策”钱有道有意试探
叶辰疑惑的看着钱有道，叶辰思考了一下，平淡的道
“一，召集落霞郡四大家族，每家500人，以及散修500人，在城外构筑第一道防线，并设奖励机制，一头一阶妖兽1000金币，二阶妖兽5000金币。并且可以优先加成城主府”
“二，府兵全部上城区，弓箭，强弩，石头，火油尽量多的准备，发出告示，青壮年修士全部上城墙，其余人准备战略物资的准备运输。并且给出奖励”
“三，安排人疏散附近的村庄，尽快安排入城或者暂时离开，只要能坚持两天，我估计四大宗门和皇城大家族，王室都会齐聚落霞山脉。”
“四，是派人传信给落云郡和星海郡，让他们做好防范”
“未足之处，还请钱郡守海涵”叶辰侃侃而谈。
“哈哈哈，好好好，果然是英雄出少年啊！”钱有道满意的看着叶辰。
“为感谢叶小友出谋献策，通报消息，让多多带你到宝库中选三件礼物，算是给叶小友的见面礼”
“郡守太客气了”叶辰谦虚道
“哈哈哈，叶小友不必推辞”
“多多，带叶小友去吧”
“是，爹爹”钱多多回了一礼
带着叶辰去了宝库
叶辰在宝库中转了一圈选了一块庚精，紫精铜
“钱姐姐，我要去趟玲珑商会，就先告辞了！”

“那，我送你吧！”钱多多陪着叶辰走的很慢二人有说有笑的走出了城主府。
“钱姐姐，再见！”叶辰径直走了，给钱多多留下了一个背影，叶辰头也不回的摇摇手。
“臭小子！”钱多多一抹微笑嘴角嘟囔着
叶辰来到了玲珑商会，见到了玉鸳鸯
“叶公子，大驾光临！有何指示？”玉鸳鸯温柔的嗤笑道
“一日不见，如隔三秋啊！几日不见，鸳鸯是越发的明艳动人了”叶辰乐呵呵的看着玉鸳鸯
“臭屁，赶紧，需要什么”玉鸳鸯佯怒的样子
“哈哈，还是鸳鸯了解我，帮我收集灵药，多多益善，灵药种子也可以，我回头去丹阁看看，四大家族种植的灵药基本上都卖给了丹阁”
“好的，我尽量给你收集，特殊的丹药你得给我留一些，我在玲珑商会拍卖”鸳鸯说
“好，我回头给你一瓶筑基丹，三品丹药，上百万金币起拍，有了筑基丹，四大家族一定拼劲全力购买的”叶辰自信满满的
“对了，叶辰，上次历练的妖兽全部处理了，总共350万金币，你拿300万金币给他们几个带回去！”鸳鸯拿出一个储物袋递给了叶辰
“好的，亲兄弟明算账，哈哈哈”叶辰笑嘻嘻的辞别了鸳鸯
又来到了丹阁
叶辰刚进门，一名小厮赶紧上前迎接“叶公子，你又来买丹药了”
叶辰笑道“你记性真好”
“叶公子说笑了，不知道叶公子今日需要什么”小厮毕恭毕敬的跟着叶辰
“你们这有灵药吗？灵药种子也行！”
“当然有啊！”小厮答道
叶辰拿出了罗列好的单子给了小厮，上面的灵药给我备100份.灵药种子各准备一斤，
小厮一听，这是大生意啊！嘴巴的激动的说不出话来，怀疑自己听错了

“叶公子，你确定吗？”
叶辰点了点头
“叶公子，你要的确实有点多了，我需要请示一下”，小厮说完，请叶辰上了二楼贵宾室
content_en:
The three of them came to the reception room
Qian Youdao asked seriously
"What Ye Xiaoyou said to Duoduo is true."
"I saw this with my own eyes," Ye Chen replied seriously
"Okay, since Xiaoyou Ye has seen it with his own eyes, I wonder if Xiaoyou Ye has any good ideas?" Qian Youdao deliberately tried to test
Ye Chen looked at Qian Youdao in confusion. Ye Chen thought about it and said calmly.
"First, summon the four major families in Luoxia County, with 500 people from each family, and 500 casual cultivators, to build the first line of defense outside the city, and set up a reward mechanism. A first-level monster is worth 1,000 gold coins, and a second-level monster is worth 5,000 gold coins. And it can be given priority to the city lord's mansion."
"Second, all the soldiers of the government will go to the city. Prepare as much bows, arrows, crossbows, stones, and kerosene as possible. Send out notices. All the young and middle-aged monks will go to the city wall. The rest will prepare to transport strategic materials. And give rewards."
"Third, arrange for people to evacuate nearby villages, and arrange to enter the city as soon as possible or leave temporarily. As long as we can persist for two days, I estimate that the four major sects, the imperial family, and the royal family will all gather in the Luoxia Mountains."
"Fourth, send someone to send a message to Luoyun County and Xinghai County to ask them to take precautions."
"If it's not enough, please ask Commander Qian to guard Haihan," Ye Chen said eloquently.
"Hahaha, good, good, good, really, a hero comes from a young age!" Qian Youdao looked at Ye Chen with satisfaction.
"To thank you, Xiaoyou Ye, for your advice and news, let Duoduo take you to the treasure house to choose three gifts, which can be regarded as a meeting gift for Xiaoyou Ye."
"The magistrate is too polite," Ye Chen said modestly
"Hahaha, little friend Ye, there is no need to refuse."
"Duoduo, take Xiaoyou Ye with you."
"Yes, daddy" Qian Duoduo said in return.
I took Ye Chen to the treasure house
Ye Chen went around the treasure house and chose a piece of Geng Essence, Purple Essence Copper
"Sister Qian, I have to go to Linglong Chamber of Commerce, so I'm going to leave now!"
"Then, let me see you off!" Qian Duoduo walked slowly with Ye Chen, and the two walked out of the city lord's mansion while talking and laughing.
"Sister Qian, goodbye!" Ye Chen walked straight away, leaving Qian Duoduo with his back. Ye Chen shook his hand without looking back.
"Smelly boy!" Qian Duoduo muttered with a smile.
Ye Chen came to Linglong Chamber of Commerce and met Yu Yuanyang
"Master Ye, you are here! What instructions do you have?" Jade Yuanyang sneered gently.
"Not seeing each other for one day is like three autumns! After not seeing each other for several days, the Yuanyang becomes more and more beautiful and charming." Ye Chen looked at the Yuanyang happily.
"Shit, hurry up, what do you need?" Yu Yuanyang pretended to be angry.
"Haha, Yuanyang still understands me and helps me collect elixirs. The more the merrier, elixir seeds are also fine. I will go back to Dan Pavilion to have a look. Basically, the elixirs grown by the four major families are sold to Dan Pavilion."
"Okay, I'll try my best to collect it for you. You have to leave some special pills for me. I'll auction them at Linglong Chamber of Commerce," Yuanyang said.
"Okay, I will give you a bottle of Foundation Establishment Pill later. It is a third-grade elixir. The starting price is millions of gold coins. With the Foundation Establishment Pill, the four major families will definitely try their best to buy it." Ye Chen said confidently
"By the way, Ye Chen, all the monsters from the last experience have been dealt with. There are 3.5 million gold coins in total. You can give them 3 million gold coins to take back!" Yuanyang took out a storage bag and handed it to Ye Chen.
"Okay, brothers will settle the score tomorrow, hahaha" Ye Chen said goodbye to Yuanyang with a smile.
Came to Dan Pavilion again
As soon as Ye Chen entered the door, a servant hurriedly came forward to greet him, "Mr. Ye, you are here to buy elixirs again."
Ye Chen smiled and said, "You have such a good memory."
"Young Master Ye is joking, I don't know what Mr. Ye needs today." The young man followed Ye Chen respectfully.
"Do you have any elixir here? elixir seeds will work too!"
"Of course!" the boy replied
Ye Chen took out the list and gave it to the boy. Prepare 100 copies of the elixir on it. Prepare one pound of each elixir seed.
When the boy heard this, he thought this was big business! My mouth was so excited that I couldn't speak, and I suspected that I heard wrongly.
"Mr. Ye, are you sure?"
Ye Chen nodded
"YeYoung Master, you really want a lot, I need to ask for permission." After the boy finished speaking, he invited Ye Chen to the VIP room on the second floor.
